SELECT 
    e.gmap_id, 
    e.name, 
    e.address, 
    e.num_of_reviews, 
    e.avg_rating, 
    e.slchd_establishment_key,
    COUNT(v.violation_id) as violation_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.inspection_id) as inspection_count
FROM establishments e
JOIN inspections i ON e.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
GROUP BY e.gmap_id, e.name, e.address, e.num_of_reviews, e.avg_rating, e.slchd_establishment_key
HAVING COUNT(v.violation_id) > 0
ORDER BY e.num_of_reviews DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    CAST(i.inspection_date AS DATE) as date,
    i.inspection_score,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 END) as critical_violations,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT vc.critical THEN 1 END) as non_critical_violations,
    COUNT(v.violation_id) as total_violations
FROM inspections i
JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
WHERE i.slchd_establishment_key = 'TEXAS ROADHOUSE|1904 W 5400 S|TAYLORSVILLE'
GROUP BY i.inspection_id, i.inspection_date, i.inspection_score
ORDER BY i.inspection_date ASC;
